motivation: Test whether a generic source-free optimizer in a fixed low-frequency function space explains the source-atlas advantage.

method_contract.coordinate_family: level plus cosine frequencies 1 through K
method_contract.optimizer: canonical BoTorch SCBO constrained posterior sampling
method_contract.optimizer_initial_design: target-only scrambled Sobol in coefficient space
method_contract.terminal_shortlist: frozen posterior objective challenger plus posterior-safe support
method_contract.terminal_verifier: same candidate-wise independent binomial all-success verifier as profile V4

equal_preverification_cost.comparison: 384 source plus 10 target calls for source atlas versus 394 target-only functional SCBO calls

endpoint_contract.primary: independently certified deployed policy is truly feasible

interpretation_contract.if_source_atlas_beats_functional_scbo: Supports source scoring beyond a generic low-frequency functional search space, within the registered generator and information contract.
interpretation_contract.if_functional_scbo_matches_or_beats_sour: The source-learning claim must be narrowed; evidence supports functional structural compression rather than source ranking.
interpretation_contract.if_both_fail_on_adverse_regimes: Retain the negative regimes and restrict the scope to ordered profiles satisfying the disclosed low-frequency assumptions.
